title: Is this plugin path safe?
hints: Split the path on backslashes and keep a stack of parts: push normal parts, ignore `.` and empty parts, pop on `..` (and give up if there is nothing to pop).
"Inside the folder" means the file starts with the folder **plus a backslash**. Without the backslash, `plugins-old` would count as inside `plugins`.
lessonTitle: Loading Only the Files You Mean
